answer_4.quote: We manually assess LED H and LED NH on two levels: (1) faithfulness of the generated text and (2) coverage of the highlighted spans in the system summary.
answer_4.guideline: Raters extract Summary Content Units (SCU) from both the system summary and the source (or highlights) using the Summary Evaluation Environment (SEE) and label each summary unit as a True Positive (TP) or False Positive (FP) to compute precision (faithfulness) and recall (coverage).
